data.label: Legend - Exam platform A3: cost-optimised Singapore design, SPOF register and change log

1  WALKTHROUGH 1 (W1-1..W1-13): DNS -> CloudFront Asia edge (PriceClass_200) -> WAF (campus IP set exempt) -> SPA from S3 -> Cognito JWT -> /api/* to ALB in Singapore -> Fargate task (either AZ) -> RDS Proxy -> RDS primary; autosave upsert every 30 s replicated synchronously to AZ b; submit -> SQS -> marker Lambda -> scores

2  WALKTHROUGH 2 (W2-1..W2-6): API records submission and returns a 5-minute presigned URL -> browser PUTs 40 MB straight to S3 (SSE-KMS) -> S3 event -> SQS notify -> notify Lambda -> SES (production access) -> tutor email; lifecycle moves the file to IA (30 d) and Glacier (180 d), expiry at 5 years

3  PEAK (load-tested 22 Nov): 3,000 students = ~5,900 req/min. BEFORE: 300 req/task target scaled 2 -> 20 tasks at 17% CPU, 4-8 min late, DB connections 8 -> 61. FIX: 3,000 req/task, pre-scale 4 tasks (2 per AZ), max 8. AFTER: 4 tasks, 28 DB connections, 17 ms server time, 0.005% errors. WAF per-IP limit blocked 95% from one IP -> campus IP set (C11)

4  FAILURE TESTS (measured): F1 RDS failover 89 s -> 16 s API outage after 2 fixes (ALB liveness /api/live without DB; require express-async-errors so DB errors no longer crash Node), 0 saves lost | F2 AZ-a isolated: 34 s intermittent, AZ-b carried all traffic | F3 bad release: auto-rollback in 2 min, 0 s outage | F4 marker broken: 0 of 3 jobs lost (DLQ + redrive)

5  COST (USD, Singapore, AWS Pricing Calculator 21 Nov 2026): normal $465.74/mo, exam $518.20/mo, annual $5,693.80, avg $474.48/mo = 47% of $1,000 budget, $0.71 per student/yr. Top 3: RDS Multi-AZ $207, NAT $87, Fargate $45. Adopted: Graviton, Savings Plan, RDS RI, scheduled scaling -> ~$391/mo

6  SPOF REGISTER: S1 Region = ACCEPTED (rebuild from Terraform + backup copy within 1 h) | S2 RDS writer = REMOVED (Multi-AZ + Proxy) | S3 NAT = REMOVED (one per AZ) | S4 API tasks = REMOVED (both AZs) | S5 ALB = REMOVED (managed, 2 AZs) | S6 CloudFront/S3/SQS/Lambda = REMOVED (managed, multi-AZ)

7  SPOF REGISTER (cont.): S7 WAF per-IP limit behind campus NAT = REMOVED (IP set / per-user limit) | S8 SES quota = ACCEPTED/MITIGATED (production access, queued sending, results visible in app) | S9 bad release = REMOVED (circuit breaker rollback) | S10 marking Lambda = REMOVED (retries + DLQ + redrive) | S11 KMS key = ACCEPTED (7-day deletion window)

8  CHANGE LOG vs A2: C1 us-east-1 -> ap-southeast-1 | C7 RDS class from load test (A2 lab r6g.large -> t4g.medium + RI) | C8 scheduled pre-scale | C9 Fargate ARM64, 1 vCPU/2 GB -> 0.5 vCPU/1 GB | C10 Savings Plan + RDS RI | C11 WAF campus IP set | C12 SES production access | C13 RDS Proxy added

9  CHANGE LOG (cont.): C14 interface endpoints REMOVED (cost > NAT GB saved), S3 gateway kept | C15 single NAT REJECTED (SPOF) | C16 upload-handler Lambda + email queue merged into notify queue/Lambda (fewer parts) | C17 CloudFront PriceClass_100 -> 200 (Asia edges for Bhutan) | C18 logs 400 d -> 30 d | C19 Budgets + anomaly detection added | C20 DynamoDB lock -> S3 native lock

10  CI/CD and IaC: every resource in Terraform; push to main -> OIDC -> terraform apply -> arm64 image to ECR -> ECS rolling deploy with circuit breaker -> S3 sync + invalidation -> smoke test; GitHub variables tune DB class, task minimum, pool size and WAF limit for load-test fix/re-test; destroy workflow stops spend after testing
